37.
Every person who commits an offence under this
Act  or  under  regulations  made  thereunder  for  which  no
punishment is expressly provided shall upon conviction after
trial by a Magistrate be liable to a fine not exceeding five
thousand rupees or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding
six months or to both such fine and imprisonment.
